Getting there

Fly into LGBI Airport, Guwahati — Tezpur is 4.5 hours on by road, across the Kolia Bhomora bridge. Hollongi Airport at Itanagar is a closer second option at just over 2 hours, though flights are fewer. We can help arrange a car, but places are limited: plan it with the contacts below early, and they will share the travel schedule closer to the date.

Stay

Everyone is staying at Greenwood Hotel. Your room allotment and check-in details will be shared with you just before you arrive — there is nothing to book or confirm from your side.
